process.title: OUR PROCESS
process.subtitle: Five steps from first sketch to a container on the water — the same order every season, so partners always know where a garment is.
process.step1.name: Brief & Development
process.step1.body: We start from your market and price point: fabrics are swatched, a tech pack is drawn, and a first sample goes out for your comment.
process.step2.name: Sampling & Fit
process.step2.body: Two to three fit rounds on live models, with measurements logged against the spec sheet until the silhouette sits exactly where you want it.
process.step3.name: Fabric & Trim Sourcing
process.step3.body: Mills are chosen for hand-feel, colour fastness and lead time. Every lot is tested before it is cut — shrinkage, pilling, colourfastness.
process.step4.name: Production
process.step4.body: Cutting, sewing and finishing run on a line schedule you can see. Mid-production inspections catch drift while it is still cheap to fix.
process.step5.name: Quality & Shipping
process.step5.body: AQL inspection before packing, then cartons are checked against the manifest and handed to your forwarder with full export documents.
about.title: ABOUT US
about.lead: We are a garment export studio. We do not own a brand — we build other people's, season after season.
about.body1: Bamboo started with one sewing floor and a handful of European buyers who wanted smaller runs than the big factories would take. That is still the work: flexible minimums, honest lead times, and samples that arrive when we said they would.
about.body2: The studio sits between two worlds. On one side, the patience of hand-finishing and natural fibres. On the other, the discipline of spec sheets, tolerances and deadlines. Most of what we do is keeping those two honest with each other.
about.cap2: Low minimum order quantities for first seasons
